components.label: Die-cast handle
components.purpose: Dark grey enamel-painted die-cast metal handle, 162 mm overall with the grille, 51 mm at the widest, 298 g.
components.limits: Taper of the handle is approximate.

components.label: Spherical steel mesh grille
components.purpose: Matte silver spherical steel mesh grille over the cardioid dynamic capsule: 50–15,000 Hz, −54.5 dBV/Pa, 150 Ω rated.

components.label: Male 3-pin XLR
components.purpose: Three-pin professional audio connector, male XLR. Positive pressure on the diaphragm gives positive voltage on pin 2 relative to pin 3.
